mapper.select: SELECT * FROM xsy_purchase_order_item WHERE deleted = FALSE AND purchase_order_id = #{purchaseOrderId} ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC
SELECT * FROM xsy_purchase_order_item WHERE deleted = FALSE AND purchase_order_id IN #{it} ORDER BY purchase_order_id ASC, sort_order ASC, id ASC
SELECT * FROM xsy_purchase_order_item WHERE deleted = FALSE AND purchase_order_id = #{purchaseOrderId} ORDER BY id ASC FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM xsy_purchase_order_item WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE FOR UPDATE
SELECT i.id FROM xsy_purchase_order_item i WHERE i.deleted = FALSE AND i.price_pending = TRUE AND i.id IN #{itemId}

SELECT DISTINCT i.purchase_order_id FROM xsy_purchase_order_item i JOIN xsy_purchase_order o ON o.id = i.purchase_order_id AND o.deleted = FALSE AND o.locked_flag = FALSE WHERE i.deleted = FALSE AND i.price_pending = TRUE AND i.price_window_started_at IS NOT NULL AND i.price_window_started_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '7 days' ORDER BY i.purchase_order_id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT count(*) FROM xsy_purchase_order_item WHERE deleted = FALSE AND purchase_order_id = #{purchaseOrderId}
